raw_sections.experience:
SUTHERLAND – Lead Data Scientist	Bengaluru, India | Dec 2021 – Present
CX-360: Conversation Intelligence Platform
Designed and implemented a multi-layer classification and summarization pipeline using Mistral LLM, Random Forest, FAISS, and GUSE embeddings.
Developed a GenAI-based Coaching System leveraging LLaMA 3.1 and Qwen 2.5 models with Alibaba-NLP embeddings for actionable coaching feedback.
Built a Suggestion Mining Engine using LLaMA 3.1 to extract structured product and process insights from dialogues.
Result: Achieved **90% KPI audit accuracy**, reduced QA workload by **60%**, and improved customer feedback quality.
Telecom Churn Analysis with Agentic AI
Architected a multi-agent churn analysis framework using LangGraph, Ollama, and PostgreSQL with Supervisor Agent orchestrating Analyst, Search, and Reporting agents.
Automated churn insights generation and strategy recommendations.
Result: Reduced manual churn analysis by **40%**, accelerating leadership decision-making.
Retail Banking RAG Chatbot
Developed retrieval-augmented chatbot using LangChain, Ollama, and FAISS with caching and reranking for Tier-1 to Tier3 queries.
Applied prompt engineering to optimize response accuracy, latency, and cost.
Result: Streamlined customer service, reducing cost-to-serve and improving response times.
Forecasting Systems
Built revenue forecasting models (Holt-Winters, SARIMA, TBATS) with **80%+ accuracy** for pipeline prediction.
Developed healthcare financial forecasting engine (N-BEATS, Prophet, SARIMA) with **91% accuracy at tier-level**.
Result: Enabled better planning, resource allocation, and financial visibility.
Deployment & Collaboration
Collaborated with engineers to package AI/ML models into APIs and dashboards using FastAPI, Streamlit, and Docker.
Hands-on exposure to scaling deployments on AWS and GCP.
DR. REDDY’S ILS – Senior Associate, Data Science	Hyderabad, India | Nov 2019 – Nov 2021
Drug Repurposing (DREAM-RD, Fragile X Syndrome): Designed AI pipeline combining bioinformatics and ML. Published results in bioRxiv, accelerating rare disease discovery.
Manufacturing Process Optimization: Applied ML + NLP for parameter prediction with **85%+ accuracy**, reducing wastage and improving efficiency.
NOBLE ANALYTICA – Junior Data Scientist	Bengaluru, India | 2017 – 2019
Biomedical Literature Mining: Built NLP pipeline with SpaCy + Transformers for drug–gene–disease relationships and applied topic modeling. Reduced manual literature review by **50%**.
